outlets.name: Time
outlets.summary: Time is leading with US domestic politics and economics - the Democratic Socialists' push inside the Democratic Party, the national debt milestone and Trump's tariff moves on food prices.

items.headline: Democratic Socialists press to reshape the Democratic Party from within
items.detail: DSA-aligned candidates have been winning primaries and drawing young voters, leaving establishment Democrats unsettled about how to respond.

items.headline: Tracking how the US national debt expanded under Trump and Biden
items.detail: Time compares debt growth across the two presidencies as the total reaches the $40 trillion mark.

items.headline: Trump and former fixer Michael Cohen patch up their feud
items.detail: The two former adversaries reconciled publicly during a radio appearance.

items.headline: White House unveils tariff arrangement intended to bring down beef costs
items.detail: Trump announced a tariff deal targeted at reducing US beef prices amid record import levels this year.

outlets.name: Variety
outlets.summary: Variety is dominated by the Paramount Skydance-Warner Bros merger fight, including a California antitrust settlement meeting and a public clash with Mark Ruffalo, alongside casting and festival news.

items.headline: Paramount Skydance to sit down with California's attorney general over merger case
items.detail: Company representatives are due to meet the state AG's office on Monday to explore settling the states' antitrust challenge to the Warner Bros deal.

items.headline: Paramount calls Mark Ruffalo's merger criticism antisemitic
items.detail: The studio responded to the actor's attack on the Ellison family by saying it does not tolerate prejudice of any kind.

items.headline: Meghan Markle in negotiations for a role in 'The Gentlemen' season three
items.detail: Variety confirmed the Duchess of Sussex is in talks to join the Guy Ritchie series just hours after reports she was weighing an acting return.

items.headline: Bonnaroo cancels its 2027 edition to recover from repeated weather damage
items.detail: Organisers are skipping a year after the Tennessee festival was scrapped several times in recent editions because of extreme weather.

outlets.name: Bloomberg
outlets.summary: Bloomberg is leading on trade and tariff diplomacy - Mexico's negotiations, India's balancing act with Russia - plus a weakening UK labour market and the economics of the AI spending boom.
outlets.note: Homepage fetch timed out; items sourced from the Bloomberg markets RSS feed and dated article URLs.

items.headline: Mexico says it can still win softer US tariffs on cars and steel
items.detail: Mexico's chief trade negotiator said he is optimistic about securing less punishing terms for Mexican automobile and steel exports to the United States.

items.headline: India's foreign minister heads to Russia while US tariff threats loom
items.detail: The trip goes ahead as Washington presses New Delhi over its continued economic ties with Moscow.

items.headline: UK jobs shrink and price pressures build in the latest global economy snapshot
items.detail: Bloomberg's weekly charting roundup shows the UK labour market weakening again last month while inflation picked up on higher energy costs.

items.headline: India's central bank reports foreign currency deposit inflows of $65.4 billion
items.detail: The Reserve Bank of India disclosed the figure as the country manages external funding amid trade tension with Washington.

items.headline: Lula holds his polling advantage over Bolsonaro with six weeks until Brazil votes
items.detail: New survey data keeps the incumbent ahead heading into the final stretch of the Brazilian election campaign.

outlets.name: BBC
outlets.summary: The BBC is leading with the collapse of US-Canada trade talks and the resulting 50% tariff, alongside the aftermath of a deadly Russian strike on a Ukrainian shopping centre.

items.headline: Ottawa pledges to mirror Washington's tariffs after negotiations collapse
items.detail: A new 50% levy on $20bn of Canadian imports took effect following a last-minute breakdown in trade talks, with Canada vowing to respond dollar for dollar.

items.headline: Search continues in Ukrainian mall rubble as Zelensky denounces the attack
items.detail: Nine people remain unaccounted for after a strike that injured 130 people, including a number of children.

items.headline: Japanese father reportedly abandoned his seven-year-old on Mount Fuji to keep climbing
items.detail: The man had brought both of his sons on the hike but is said to have left one behind when the boy grew tired.

items.headline: US rapper BigXthaPlug taken into custody over drug and weapons allegations
items.detail: The rapper, who has faced similar charges before, had been scheduled to perform at the Country Rising Festival.

items.headline: Sydney Marathon's new medal accidentally features Munich's stadium
items.detail: Online sleuths spotted the mistake after the race unveiled its double-sided medal design.

outlets.name: France 24
outlets.summary: France 24 is leading with a joint French-British ex-diplomats' letter accusing Israel of ethnic cleansing, plus continued Russian strikes on Ukraine and African crisis coverage.
outlets.note: Homepage previously returned a login wall; items taken from the dated live-news wire index, all with 20260822 URL stamps.

items.headline: Around 100 retired French and British ambassadors accuse Israel of ethnic cleansing
items.detail: The former envoys signed an open letter urging Paris and London to act jointly to uphold international law in the Palestinian territories.

items.headline: Two children killed in fresh Russian strikes a day after the mall attack
items.detail: The new casualties follow the Kryvyi Rih shopping centre drone strike that killed 16 people and left at least nine missing.

items.headline: Indonesia sends hundreds of troops to fight wildfires on Borneo
items.detail: Thick smog has settled over parts of the island, which holds both pristine rainforest and extensive plantations.

items.headline: South Korea trials an Arctic shipping route as Middle East conflict snarls trade lanes
items.detail: Seoul dispatched its first trial container shipment through the Arctic after the war disrupted established global shipping routes.

outlets.name: Al Jazeera
outlets.summary: Al Jazeera is leading with Tehran calling new US sanctions a declaration of war against all nations, alongside the US-Canada tariff rupture and worsening African health and security stories.

items.headline: Tehran brands fresh US sanctions a declaration of war on every country
items.detail: Iranian officials said the measures violate the sovereignty of other states as Trump maintains that Tehran is not ready for a deal.

items.headline: Washington slaps 50 percent duties on $20bn of Canadian goods after talks fail
items.detail: Canada's prime minister said his country would match the tariffs dollar for dollar following the failure to reach an agreement.

items.headline: Over 16,000 Ervebo vaccine doses land in DR Congo as Ebola spreads
items.detail: Health authorities warn that roughly one person is dying from Ebola every thirty minutes in the current outbreak, the largest on record with nearly 2,500 deaths.

items.headline: Ex-world champion boxer Zolani Tete gunned down in South Africa
items.detail: The 38-year-old former titleholder was shot and killed outside his home.

items.headline: UNICEF warns Somalia's child hunger emergency is worsening after aid reductions
items.detail: The agency says cuts to humanitarian funding have deepened malnutrition among Somali children.
